note: Independent source rejudgment. draft-ietf-bess-mup-safi-01 Section 3.1.3.1 (rfc/drafts/draft-ietf-bess-mup-safi.txt:443-457): "Parse TLVs one by one per Section 3.1.5; unknown TLV types MUST be ignored for local processing and MUST be propagated unchanged when re-advertising the route to other BGP peers; any TLV parsing error MUST result in Treat-as-withdraw; TLVs are not part of the NLRI key for route processing." Read Section 3.1.5 and all three defined TLVs: each applies to ST2, so T1ST validates their framing and ignores their values. Read both tagged units: TestMUPT1STTLVFraming in internal/component/bgp/plugins/nlri/mup/draft_ietf_bess_mup_safi_tlv_mup_test.go accepts a complete TLV, rejects a lone header byte, and requires ErrMUPTLV when Length 5 exceeds the available two value bytes. TestMUPMalformedT1STTreatAsWithdraw in internal/component/bgp/reactor/draft_ietf_bess_mup_safi_t1st_withdraw_test.go isolates Length 5 with one value byte after complete mandatory fields, first seeds valid K0 of the same RD/prefix, and requires exact surviving sibling bytes plus exactly K0 in a decodable MP_UNREACH, with ActionNone/no reset and no extra withdrawal body. This catches retaining, merely dropping, or withdrawing the malformed bytes instead of the held generation. Producers read: mup/types.go ParseMUP, ValidateNLRI, decode, parseBodyT1ST and validateTLVs; mup/rfc7606.go recognizerFor; reactor/session_validation.go applyRFC7606; session_validation_nlritype.go applyTypedNLRIDiscard, typedNLRIEdit, typedNLRIRelayEdit and typedNLRIPlaceWithdrawals; session_validation_nlritype_held.go typedNLRIWalk.withdrawal. validateTLVs checks both header truncation and value overrun on each iteration; recognizer and session convert its error to the tested withdrawal. Scope has no partial or exclusion annotation. No checks or native discrimination run by this auditor.
